messages:
Ana (CEO): Quick note: all-hands next Tue 11am PT. We'll keep it 40m. Main bits: a short code-freeze policy update, a demo of Private onboarding flows, and two customer shout-outs. Please add Qs below or drop into the form.
Marta (People Ops): Zoom + live captions on. Recording will go to the company channel after. If you want to present, react with :star:.
Priya (Product): Demo is a walkthrough of the Private onboarding checklist + sample VPC setup. Need a live terminal for 5 minutes. Jordan, can Eng run one ephemeral node?
Jordan (Eng): Yup, can spin one. I'll bring the infra screenshot and a tiny demo script. Will keep commands in a fenced block for the recording:
```
# demo snippet
export REDWOOD_ENV=private
./start-onboard --customer=acme --region=us-west2
```
Devon (Security): Heads-up on the code-freeze policy change: during major launches we now enforce a 48-hour freeze window for infra rollouts. Ill present the rationale and link the short FAQ. Send questions to security-questions@redwood.company.
Alex (Sales): Can we include a 2-min highlight about onboarding timeline expectations? Sales and CS would appreciate a single line we can share with prospects.
Priya (Product): Yes — Ill include a single-slide customer-facing timeline (1-2-3 weeks).
Ravi (Support): Also flagging one current ticket about onboarding IAM roles. I'll drop the ticket link in the doc.
Sam (EngOpsBot): Calendar event created: All-Hands  Tue 11:00 AM PT (evt_1755556789). Recording enabled.
Ana (CEO): Agenda:
1) Exec summary  5m
2) Policy update: code-freeze for infra launches (Devon)  5m
3) Private onboarding demo (Priya + Jordan)  12m
4) Customer highlights & sales alignment (Alex)  6m
5) Support update on current triage (Ravi)  4m
6) Q&A + close  8m
Please keep slides to a minimum. Link to slide deck in the invite.
--- (POST-MEETING) ---
Sam (EngOpsBot): Recording: https://recordings.redwood.company/1755556789-allhands-tue. Transcript: https://recordings.redwood.company/1755556789-transcript.txt
Priya (Product): Takeaways: Private onboarding demo completed end-to-end. Action: Priya -> publish the condensed onboarding checklist in product docs by EOD Thu.
Jordan (Eng): Demo notes: ephemeral node used; small tweak needed for startup script to handle rate limit errors. Action: Jordan -> open a patch PR and link QA test by Wed.
Devon (Security): Policy change accepted. Action: Devon -> post FAQ and run an office-hours session on Friday 9am PT for teams doing infra launches.
Alex (Sales): Shared customer timeline snippet and a one-pager with sales enablement. Action: Alex -> sync with CS for distribution.
Ravi (Support): IAM ticket resolved; follow-up doc in support playbooks. Action: Ravi -> add a troubleshooting step for role mapping.
Marta (People Ops): Short poll on meeting length/preferences: https://survey.redwood.company/allhands-length. Please respond by Fri.
Ana (CEO): Thanks for concise updates. If anything was missed in Q&A tag the owner in this thread and we'll get it closed out. :sparkles:
